findings.title: Precise workspace bounds are not forwarded
findings.mechanism: Page consumes start/end calendar labels and passes them to the hook; query key and URL omit the available startInstant/endInstantExclusive. Minute-by-minute rolling windows can share an unchanged calendar key, and exclusive/local-day semantics are lost before the request seam.
findings.reproduction: Use a 24h header range whose instant lower/upper bounds move without changing calendar labels. Inert actual-hook probe received start=2026-10-13&end=2026-10-14, not precise RFC3339 bounds. No real request issued; server filtering remains unproved.
findings.fix: Consume shared precise bounds; pass both through typed hook and cache identity, preserving cancellation, vehicle selection, pagination/reset and server semantics. Validate inclusive lower/exclusive upper in separately authorized integration.
findings.confidence: high for cited source mechanism; mounted behavior NOTRUN
findings.queueDisposition: No existing exact Phase6 software-update fix owner found; predecessor stays completed. Orchestrator must assign a narrow source-exclusive follow-up, not reopen migration.

findings.title: Initial paused history is shown as unavailable prerequisite data
findings.mechanism: For selected vehicle + undefined data + isPending=true + isLoading=false + fetchStatus=paused, shared DataState is initial/blocked. Local presenter is neither loading nor available; refreshBlocked additionally requires an array. Summary/status/timeline take unavailable branches and cadence uses unavailable copy. VehicleSourceContent retains only paused data with hasData=true.
findings.reproduction: Exact-source probe: shared status=initial/isRefreshBlocked=true; local available=false/initialLoading=false; page refreshBlocked=false. Thus the selected vehicle is told to select a vehicle instead of learning that the initial read is paused. Native header may independently expose freshness; that does not repair these section branches.
findings.fix: Render explicit source-local initial-paused explanation/retry while counts remain null and all shells stay mounted. Reuse existing VehicleSourcePause rather than add a competing component; keep retained-pause separate.
findings.confidence: high for cited source mechanism; mounted behavior NOTRUN

findings.title: Unknown update lifecycle becomes Available and disappears from distribution
findings.mechanism: getUpdateStatus falls back to known available metadata. Breakdown filters solely to the five known keys, dropping unknown identities/counts while retaining them in the denominator. These are two manifestations of one status-identity defect, counted once.
findings.reproduction: Actual source metadata returns Available for future-status and constructor. Actual breakdown initializer returns only installed for {installed:1,future-status:1}, and [] for {future-status:2}. Existing tests assert this fallback/omission; historical or future green tests would not prove the required unknown-state contract.
findings.fix: Preserve raw unknown/future lifecycle identity with localized neutral metadata and uncategorized count, preserving known order, all-row denominator and prototype-safety check. Serialize matching page-test expectation changes with the page owner.
findings.confidence: high for cited source mechanism; mounted behavior NOTRUN

findings.title: A full page supplies a fabricated exact result total
findings.mechanism: For 50 rows on page 1, paginationTotal is 51. Pagination defaults totalKind to exact because the caller passes no totalKind. It announces Showing 1–50 of 51 and derives two pages despite no total/next-page proof in the array contract.
findings.reproduction: Actual-source initializer yields totalProp=51 for returnedRows=50; actual Pagination signature defaults to exact. This proves a source total/provenance error, not whether the backend honors offset.
findings.fix: Use existing unknown/loaded total presentation with separately source-backed next-page capability. Do not invent exact totals or delete pagination actions to mask missing integration. Establish safe paging capability with hook/backend owner before changing navigation semantics.
findings.confidence: high for cited source mechanism; mounted behavior NOTRUN

findings.title: View all time resets to workspace default instead
findings.mechanism: All empty-state recovery variants use resetRange with View all time. On both header-owned aliases, useRangeState overrides page default all with saved defaultAnalysisRange (7d fallback); reset resolves that effective default, not all.

Clicking this advertised recovery therefore need not select all time; no UI action was issued in this audit.

findings.title: Date/month display and month bins use host preferences
findings.mechanism: monthLabel passes undefined locale; month buckets use browser getFullYear/getMonth; all four formatDate calls omit supported locale/tz options. Numeric displays subscribe to saved locale, so selected-language/timezone dates can disagree with the rest of the page. This is one preference-consumption defect, not four separate counts.
findings.reproduction: Actual monthLabel probe: host en-US, selected fr-FR, actual Mar 26 vs preferred mars 26. Actual dateFormat probe with number-format bridge fr-FR but omitted opts: Feb 28, 2026 vs explicit selected 28 févr. 2026. Timezone reliance is source-confirmed from omitted options/local getters; differing-timezone native rendering was not run.
findings.fix: Use existing selected locale/timezone presentation APIs consistently for date text and month semantics; include preference dependencies when memoized. Preserve raw ISO timestamps, engineering SI cadence seconds, specialist day formatting and existing ranges.
findings.confidence: high for cited source mechanism; mounted behavior NOTRUN
